newsitem.title: UK: Citibank sets warrants on DAX/Bund and JGB futures.
newsitem.headline: Citibank sets warrants on DAX/Bund and JGB futures.

text.p: Citibank NA says it has issued 100 million American-style call and put warrants, on the DAX, the LIFFE-Bund-Future and the LIFFE-JGB-Future.

There are 12 tranches of warrants on the DAX index, of which there are six tranches of calls and six tranches of puts. The call tranches have five million warrants each. One of the put tranches has five million warrants and the remaining five tranches have one million warrants per tranche.
There are eight tranches of warrants on the LIFFE-Bund-Future index, four tranches of calls and four tranches of puts. All have five million warrants per tranche.
There are also two tranches of calls and two tranches of puts on the LIFFE-JGB-Future index. Each tranche consists of five million warrants.
